title: The evening, everyone at once
problem: The evening goes stall by stall; each stall waits its turn to build, and a solo player watches every computer's turn first.
scope: Every stall decides its evening at the same time and says when it is done; night falls when all are done
Priority settled at nightfall by today's line-up; the other cards return to their hands
Online rooms, takeover and reconnect; pass-and-play hand-over; the evening screens and beats; RULES.md and the Priority card text

approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-13, in his own words: "also make so that each player access and build the upgrade together rather than waiting player by player".

added: The evening is one shared step: every stall decides at once and says Lights out; night falls when all are done
A rival's box says deciding or closed in the evening; the bar waits by name only after your Lights out
changed: Priority: several may be played; at nightfall the stall earliest in today's line-up goes first and the other cards go back to their hands (the card, RULES.md, the evening sheet and the next morning say so)
Computers decide their evening at once as it opens; their builds and cards are one beat, each label on its own stall
removed: Waiting for each stall's evening turn

playerNotes: In the evening everyone decides at the same time: no more waiting for each stall's turn
Several Priority cards can be played in one evening: the stall earliest in the line-up buys first, and the other cards go back to their hands
